name: markdown-embed-transclusion
description: Local Quartz 5 transformer plugin that recognises this vault's Markdown-syntax note embeds (`![alt](Note.md#Heading)` — Obsidian's embed syntax when Wikilinks are disabled) and transcludes the target heading/page the same way `![[Note#Heading]]` wikilink embeds already do. obsidian-flavored-markdown only handles the wikilink form, so this syntax otherwise renders as a broken .

quartz.name: markdown-embed-transclusion
quartz.description: Transcludes Markdown-syntax note/section embeds (![alt](Note.md#Heading)) the same way wikilink embeds are transcluded.
